ayahs.1: Doob kar sakhti se kheenchne walon ki qasam!
ayahs.2: Band khol kar chhuda dene walon ki qasam!
ayahs.3: Aur tairne phirne walon ki qasam!
ayahs.4: Phir daud kar aage badhne walon ki qasam!
ayahs.5: Phir kaam ki tadbeer karne walon ki qasam!
ayahs.7: Us ke baad ek peechhe aane wali (peechhe peechhe) aayegi.
ayahs.8: (Bahut se) dil us din dhadakte honge.
ayahs.10: Kehte hain ke kya hum pehli ki si haalat ki taraf phir lautaaye jaaenge?
ayahs.11: Kya us waqt jab ke hum boseeda haddiyan ho jaaenge?
ayahs.12: Kehte hain ke phir to yeh lautna nuqsaan-deh hai.
ayahs.13: (Maloom hona chaahiye) woh to sirf ek (khaufnaak) daant hai.
ayahs.14: Ke (jis ke zaahir hote hi) woh ek dam maidan mein jama ho jaaenge.
ayahs.15: Kya Moosa (alaihis salaam) ki khabar tumhein pahunchi hai?
ayahs.16: Jab ke unhein un ke Rabb ne paak maidan Tuwaa mein pukaara.
ayahs.17: (Ke) tum Firaun ke paas jao, us ne sarkashi ikhtiyar kar li hai.
ayahs.18: Us se kaho ke kya tu apni durustagi aur islaah chaahta hai.
ayahs.19: Aur yeh ke main tujhe tere Rabb ki raah dikhaoon taake tu (us se) darne lage.
ayahs.21: To us ne jhutlaya aur nafarmani ki.
ayahs.23: Phir sab ko jama karke pukaara.
ayahs.24: Tum sab ka Rabb main hi hoon.
ayahs.25: To (sab se buland-o-baala) Allah ne bhi use aakhirat ke aur dunya ke azaab mein giraftaar kar liya.
ayahs.26: Beshak is mein us shakhs ke liye ibrat hai jo dare.
ayahs.27: Kya tumhara paida karna zyada dushwaar hai ya aasman ka? Allah Taala ne use banaya.
ayahs.28: Us ki bulandi oonchi ki phir use theek-thaak kar diya.
ayahs.29: Us ki raat ko taareek banaya aur us ke din ko nikaala.
ayahs.30: Aur us ke baad zameen ko (hamwaar) bichha diya.
ayahs.31: Is mein se paani aur chaara nikaala.
ayahs.33: Yeh sab tumhare aur tumhare jaanwaron ke faayde ke liye (hain).
ayahs.34: Pas jab woh badi aafat (qayamat) aa jaayegi.
ayahs.35: Jis din ke insaan apne kiye hue kaamon ko yaad karega.
ayahs.36: Aur (har) dekhne wale ke saamne jahannam zaahir ki jaayegi.
ayahs.38: Aur dunyawi zindagi ko tarjeeh di (hogi).
ayahs.39: Us ka thikaana jahannam hi hai.
ayahs.40: Haan jo shakhs apne Rabb ke saamne khade hone se darta raha hoga aur apne nafs ko khwahish se roka hoga.
ayahs.41: To us ka thikaana jannat hi hai.
ayahs.42: Log aap se qayamat ke waqe hone ka waqt daryaaft karte hain.
ayahs.43: Aap ko is ke bayan karne se kya taalluq?
ayahs.44: Is ke ilm ki intehaa to Allah ki jaanib hai.
ayahs.45: Aap to sirf us se darte rehne walon ko aagaah karne wale hain.
ayahs.46: Jis roz yeh use dekh lenge to aisa maloom hoga ke sirf din ka aakhri hissa ya awwal hissa hi (dunya mein) rahe hain.
